hints.title: Dual Case Requirement
hints.text: A letter is valid if both its lowercase and uppercase forms are present in string s.

hints.title: Descending Alphabet Scan
hints.text: Inspect uppercase letters from 'Z' down to 'A' to stop immediately upon the first valid letter.

hints.title: Fast Membership Lookup
hints.text: Store all characters of s in a set for constant-time presence checks.

hints.title: Descending Character Search Implementation

complexity.notes: Building character set takes O(n); checking 26 alphabet letters takes O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the string repeatedly for each letter takes O(26 * n); set lookup is O(1).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set of at most 52 distinct characters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks letters from Z to A in descending order for immediate early return.
